title: EPOC: An Efficient Pulse Generation Framework with Advanced Synthesis for Quantum Circuits
problem: Quantum optimal control has high computational overhead and generates long circuit latencies; gate-based pulse generation requires substantial resource overhead.
motivation: Reducing pulse generation computational cost and circuit latency is critical for practical quantum circuit execution on near-term quantum devices.
method: EPOC combines ZX-Calculus, circuit partitioning, and advanced circuit synthesis for efficient pulse generation. The approach implements finer granularity in pulse generation and explores equivalent circuit representations to increase parallelism. ZX-Calculus enables compact circuit abstraction and optimization, while partitioning allows parallel processing of circuit segments.
key_novelty: First framework combining ZX-Calculus with circuit partitioning and synthesis for low-overhead, high-parallelism quantum pulse generation.
contributions: Novel combination of ZX-Calculus and circuit partitioning for pulse generation
Finer-granularity pulse generation enabling increased parallelism
31.74% latency reduction vs. prior work; 76.80% reduction vs. gate-based methods
